name: Agree the purpose and participants
summary: Write down who should benefit, who wants to join, and which buildings or installations could take part.
document: Participant and installation list; statement of purpose

name: Choose the legal and sharing pathway
summary: Distinguish an ACC arrangement from a CER or CCE legal entity. Confirm the current rules, proximity and intended activities with DGEG.
document: Chosen pathway, proposed legal form and eligibility questions

name: Set governance and appoint the EGAC
summary: Agree decision-making, joining and leaving, responsibilities and how benefits and costs will be allocated. Name the entity that will represent the sharing group.
document: Governance decisions, internal rules, EGAC appointment

name: Check the project and financing
summary: Assess roof/site rights, generation and consumption profiles, installation design, maintenance and costs. Separate project estimates from measured outcomes.
document: Site rights, technical proposal, financial assumptions

name: Prepare the DGEG registration
summary: Follow the official portal process, identifying participating installations and their roles. Verify the registration and licensing documents required for the project.
document: Portal application and supporting installation records

name: Resolve network and metering requirements
summary: Follow the network assessment and check the suitability of meters. Establish which data permissions and network-use arrangements apply.
document: Network assessment, metering confirmation, consent records

name: Confirm approval and activate sharing
summary: Complete the applicable certification process, confirm allocation settings, and conclude the network-use contract where public-network sharing requires one.

name: Review the community’s operation
summary: Review data, charges, maintenance and member arrangements. Compare actual results with the original assumptions and keep members informed.
document: Operating records, maintenance plan, member reports
